purpose: Teach: 輸出入/顛末/参与/受け手/撤収/マージン/例示/売り出し

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正輸出入の摘発を継続します
lines.en: We will continue our enforcement operations against illegal imports and exports.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Steady vocal weight on 'continue.' Professional distance — speaking from institutional authority, not personal conviction. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、事件の顛末を市民に公開されますね
lines.en: Yes. The police will be making the details of this case public to citizens, won't they?
lines.style: Attentive, slightly deferential. A gentle question framed as acknowledgment — seeking confirmation rather than challenging. Respectful pacing, warm underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民安全協議会への参与をお引き受けします
lines.en: We will take on a role in the citizen safety council.
lines.style: Formal announcement. Steady vocal weight, no inflection on personal stance. Speaking as institutional voice. Clear, administrative, matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、捜査資料も受け手目線でわかりやすくされてますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are making investigation documents clear and accessible to the public, aren't they?
lines.style: Acknowledging with genuine warmth. Soft emphasis on 'accessible' — noticing and approving the effort. Still respectful in register, but the tone softens into almost appreciation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場対応の撤収判断は慎重にします
lines.en: We are careful and deliberate about our decisions to withdraw from crime scenes.
lines.style: Composed, careful. Slight weight on 'deliberate.' Speaking from experience and responsibility — not hurried, not defensive. Measured cadence throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、不正マージン詐欺の事件を捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are investigating cases of illegal commission fraud, aren't they?
lines.style: Attentive follow-up, warm interest. Gentle rise at the end — genuinely curious about confirmation. Conversational but still respectful. Natural rhythm, not rushed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯講習で具体例を例示しております
lines.en: We provide concrete examples in our crime prevention workshops.
lines.style: Direct, informational. Even vocal weight, no inflection. Speaking about completed work matter-of-factly. Professional distance, but not cold — just unadorned.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、不正商品の売り出しを摘発されますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are cracking down on the sale of counterfeit goods, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm recognition with a touch of ease. The 'Close' instruction suggests Kenji and Takeda have built some rapport — this line sits at the boundary between official and familiar. Still respectful, but the tension eases slightly.
